notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, design or history for this tower was found in any source read. The NWS page describes a state forestry office next to a fire tower about 1,247 ft up in western Loudon County but does not name the tower, so linking it to record LOT001 (1,252 ft) is an inference, not a confirmed match; a human should decide whether to keep that sentence. The tnlandforms per-tower pages returned unrelated gambling spam rather than tower details, so the site may have been compromised; a human should check it. The 2014 list is the latest status evidence, so current standing is unverified. Access is unknown and the tower may sit on a working state site.
